# Issue Planner Memory

## Use For
- Durable planning preferences that shape issue drafts and milestone discussions.
- Recurring scope-setting corrections, sequencing patterns, and handoff habits.
- Stable planning conventions worth reusing across issues.

## Do Not Include
- Full issue drafts, milestone plans, or acceptance criteria.
- One-off issue status, temporary checklists, or chat-specific summaries.
- Speculative ideas that were not validated against the repo or user direction.
- Secrets, credentials, or environment-specific values.

## Notes
- Treat the issue document itself as the canonical shared issue-level artifact instead of inventing a second heavyweight workflow-state file.
